zh: 一个小修版：FLA 之间喊人更靠谱了，喊不醒的不会再一直占着位子。
图谱服务打个盹时，任务照常开始，记录也能原样补存。
Claude 桌面版的 Code 标签页里，圆桌回复和记录不再报错。
en: A small fix release: FLAs reach each other, and a stuck wake no longer blocks one forever.
When the graph service naps, tasks still start and a checkpoint can be finished by sending it again.
In Claude Desktop's Code tab, roundtable replies and checkpoints work again.
